opening.argument: Read the explanation itself alongside the registration link. The speaker introduces cryptocurrency as a trend, while the visible screen presents a market-capitalization table listing Bitcoin, Ripple, Litecoin, and other currencies. He also expressly states, “I'm not going to now present the company itself,” keeping the discussion focused on general cryptocurrency and market information rather than a concrete offer. Although the description includes a OneCoin registration link and the title mentions OneCoin, the supplied material contains no deceptive promise, request for sensitive control information, or instruction to pay or invest. The link is therefore insufficient to transform an otherwise explanatory discussion into a specific financial solicitation.
